name: editing-experiment
description: Lightweight ingest, captioning, develop and FTP app for sports photographers.

scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm build:native && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:demo: vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts --testNamePattern='ingests three sources|Photo Mechanic template|code replacement|Lightroom preset and a moved exposure|wires the histogram|crops to 1:1|detects faces|finishes at the export size|edited in the film strip|linear image too|batch exports a retouched photo|full-resolution crop'
scripts.test:e2e:crop: vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/real-mode.smoke.test.ts --testNamePattern='Lightroom-style crop overlay|real mode smoke'
scripts.test:e2e:export: vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts --testNamePattern='batch exports three|batch exports and sends|never overwrites'
